title: Interactive graphical user interfaces for simulated systems

source_provenance.note: Ephemeral request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted.

publicly_described_functional_concepts: visualizing multiple models that collectively represent a real-world system
associating interface nodes with models and time-based input data
simulating model state and updating node appearance for a selected point in time
graph- or map-based exploration of simulated objects and relationships
trend, information, simulation, mapping, schematic, time, equipment, and alert-oriented panels
interactive charts, histograms, annotations, and state-dependent visual styling
using measured or historical data to inform model simulation and operator analysis

scope_model.analysis_loop: select authorized models and data -> run or replay simulation -> compute node/object properties over time -> project state into graph/map/panel UI -> scrub or compare scenarios -> surface alerts/assumptions -> require human decision for consequential real-world actions
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: separate model definitions, scenario inputs, simulation outputs, and UI state
treat time as a first-class navigation dimension
link every displayed simulation value back to model version and source inputs
support graph, map, chart, and schematic views over the same canonical object state
keep simulation outcomes distinct from observed real-world measurements
provide side-by-side scenario comparison and uncertainty indicators
use simulation for decision support rather than automatic high-impact physical control

independent_claim_themes: UI nodes associated with models and time-based data
updating node appearance based on simulation results and selected time
graph/map views with interactive charts or related panels
